comment: Suite registry for scripts/verify.sh (TASK-2). Status is ACTIVE (the entry point runs it now) or PENDING (the owning task has not built it yet). Only the owning task flips PENDING to ACTIVE, by editing this file. A PENDING suite is never run, is never printed as passed, and is not evidence of parity or compatibility.

suites.name: build
suites.description: mvn verify on JDK 17+ with production compilation at --release 11 (DEC-3); module shells only, no parity claimed

suites.name: dependency-policy
suites.description: maven-enforcer bans Kotlin, kotlinx and Kotlin-backed okio artifacts from production scope including transitives; test and build tooling exempt (DEC-4)

suites.name: bytecode-java11
suites.description: module jars and production dependency jars expose only class files Java 11 can select (major <= 55, multi-release aware); today the production dependency set is empty and is reported as such

suites.name: runtime-tests
suites.description: applicable upstream wire-runtime test cases with tracked adaptations (DEC-5); interim key is the wire-runtime-java module total inside mvn verify (adapted plus port-only cases); TASK-14 owns per-case reconciliation

suites.name: schema-tests
suites.description: applicable upstream wire-schema test cases with tracked adaptations (DEC-5); interim key is the wire-schema-java module total inside mvn verify (adapted plus port-only cases); per-case ledger docs/task13-case-accounting.md, reconciliation TASK-14

suites.name: protoc-oracle
suites.description: protoc compatibility oracle at the pinned tag as a blocking CI check

suites.name: compiler-tests
suites.description: Java generator behavior tests and golden output checks

suites.name: security-corpus
suites.description: security regression corpus as permanent tests

suites.name: java11-consumer
suites.description: placeholder consumer main compiled and run on an actual Java 11 JVM against the module jars; the placeholder certifies nothing about compatibility, TASK-5 and TASK-21 carry the real smokes (DEC-3)

suites.name: duplicate-class-check
suites.description: class-origin report plus duplicate detection for com.squareup.wire and retained okio names on every module test classpath (compatibility matrix section G)
